query_analysis.original_query: In membrane separations, how do concentration polarization effects impact mass transfer, and what strategies can minimize these effects?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Analyze the mechanisms by which concentration polarization phenomena influence mass transfer across membranes in separation processes, and identify potential mitigation strategies to minimize the adverse impacts of these effects on separation performance.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative analysis of concentration polarization effects and mitigation strategies
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Joint investigation of mass transfer mechanisms and performance optimization
